task.title: P6-116: Make removal toast report the count actually removed
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 1 — Destructive actions and data integrity). Original id: P6-116. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/collection-api.md.

**The removal toast reports the count that was rendered, not the count that was removed** (was `P6-055c`). `lib.rs:629` sends `quantity: None` — the whole stack, now a deliberate choice per `lib.rs:615-617` — while the toast is built from the rendered `c.from` (`collection.rs:1527-1535`). A stack grown in another tab loses more copies than the toast names, and the toast is the user's only record. Fix by having the receipt carry the count actually removed.
